text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On her day off after the race, Cheval 
Grand went to the food court, but...

text_block_list.name: Regular Shop's Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Cheval-chan! What can I get for you? 
...Well, not that I even need to ask!

text_block_list.name: Regular Shop's Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Top choice is the usual Chinese starchy 
sauce stir-fry! Or maybe meat buns... 
right?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"...U-Um... excuse me... Rather than a 
meat bun, an anman... I'm in the mood for 
something sweet."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"Red bean steamed buns... and sesame 
balls, or maybe almond tofu would be nice 
too..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Perhaps Cheval Grand is still feeling the 
fatigue from the race. It looks like we'll 
need to reconsider our upcoming racing 
schedule."
